reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a tutorial on joining an Amazon affiliate program, generating product links, and receiving commissions when users purchase through those links. The earnings example, payment form, and visible affiliate-account workflow provide context for the financial references, while they do not by themselves establish deceptive claims or a loss.

opening.argument: The video ties an income opportunity to a concrete chain of viewer actions: joining an affiliate program, creating product links, sharing them, and inducing purchases. It explicitly presents the process as requiring no investment, while describing commission income from purchases made through the link. That is a low-barrier cash-acquisition pitch, even if the mechanism is labeled affiliate marketing. The viewer is directed toward registration and promotion, with the reward framed as the outcome of participation rather than merely discussed as background.

click the country which you're searching in the right side

this link can be shared with facebook, youtube, whatsapp etc

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the process an Amazon affiliate tutorial does not remove the solicitation. The presentation still connects registration, link distribution, and purchases to a monetary return. The cited workflow establishes the mechanics, but it does not establish that viewers will receive the advertised level of income, that the opportunity is suitable for them, or that the linked conditions are adequately disclosed.

citations.quote: Ok , we have joined amazon as affiliate
after buying this link you will get the affiliate income with this item

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The argument treats ordinary performance-based advertising as a guaranteed reward, but the evidence does not show a guaranteed payment to viewers. It says income follows only when someone buys through an affiliate link, and the account workflow identifies an Amazon Associates account rather than a mystery payment service. The existence of registration and link sharing therefore supports a disclosed commercial tutorial, not deception.

citations.quote: after buying this link you will get the affiliate income with this item
Ok , we have joined amazon as affiliate

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: the title promises money without investment, the video highlights a rupee earnings figure, and the process requests sensitive banking information before payment. The account screen is described as showing a minimum threshold, while the demonstrated result is presented as evidence that the model works. This combination can make a simple online-income path appear unusually accessible and financially reliable, even though the material does not establish typical earnings, eligibility, timing, or the practical limits on receiving commissions.

citations.quote: How to Make Money online without investment
Once you get minimum INR1000
If only 10 people could buy the same product, he would have received 5760 rupees

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense emphasizes an account workflow but leaves the strongest risk signals unexplained: the no-investment framing, the displayed earnings, and the collection of bank-account and IFSC information. A disclaimer or ordinary account form cannot by itself validate the implied accessibility of the returns. The evidence instead shows viewers being encouraged to pursue income while important conditions remain unstated.

citations.quote: In this, type your bank card no
he would have received 5760 rupees

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The risk framing overstates what the evidence shows. The payment screen presents bank details as part of receiving affiliate proceeds, and the earnings example is conditional on purchases rather than a fixed return. Nothing cited establishes a loss, a required deposit, fabricated earnings, or a promise that every viewer will earn. Financial information in a payout workflow is therefore not, by itself, evidence of a scam.

citations.quote: after buying this link you will get the affiliate income with this item

opening.argument: Although presented as education, the video functions as promotion because it repeatedly directs viewers toward participation and distribution. It tells viewers to use affiliate links across social platforms, invites people who want online income to watch and share, and presents the creator's own reported result as a model to follow. The educational label therefore does not neutralize the commercial steering: the practical endpoint is recruiting participants into a commission-generating activity and encouraging them to circulate purchase links.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational disclaimer addresses legality and copyright, not whether the video steers viewers toward a financially rewarding activity. The calls to share the video and use social media for affiliate income show an active promotional purpose. Describing the activity as instruction does not answer whether the income framing is sufficiently qualified or whether the audience is being encouraged to act on an attractive example.

citations.quote: use in whatsapp, facebook and social media to generate affiliate income
Share this video to those, who want to earn money online

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of a disclosed affiliate program is compatible with educational instruction. The evidence describes how to join, create links, and earn only when customers purchase; it does not show hidden recruitment tiers, an entry fee, or a guaranteed return. The disclaimer and tutorial framing are consistent with an instructional video explaining a commercial platform, while the cited calls to share do not prove fraudulent intent.
